title: Documentation Consolidation Template
description: Template for analyzing and consolidating documentation repositories
author: Devin AI

operations.name: analyze_documentation_structure
operations.description: Analyze current documentation structure and identify issues

operations.name: verify_system_state
operations.description: Verify current system state against documentation

commands.content: Documentation consolidation analysis with findings, recommendations, and implementation plan

operations.name: update_core_documentation
operations.description: Update core documentation files with current state

commands.content: Updated README with current system state and accurate references
Update documentation index to reflect new structure

operations.name: archive_outdated_files
operations.description: Move outdated documentation to archive directory

commands.purpose: Create archive directory for old files

commands.command: mv <TARGET_DIR>/*<OUTDATED_PATTERN>*.md <TARGET_DIR>/archive/<ARCHIVE_DIR>/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Files already moved or not found'

variables.OUTDATED_DATE_PATTERN: Date pattern to identify outdated files (e.g., 2026-06-25)

notes: This template assumes markdown documentation files - adjust for other formats
System verification commands assume Linux environment - adapt for other systems
File patterns should be customized based on actual naming conventions
Archive structure should follow organizational standards
Always test consolidation on non-production systems first
best_practices: Maintain change log for documentation updates
